He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper…
Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.

So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

translations.web: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Yahweh, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
translations.bsb: Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion; break up your unplowed ground. For it is time to seek the LORD until He comes and sends righteousness upon you like rain.
translations.kjv: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness
translations.asv: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness; break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Jehovah, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
